title_zh: 英國調查：43% 受訪兒童曾用 AI 聊天機器人求情緒支援
title_en: UK children AI chatbot use for emotional support survey Barnardos NCPS
summary_zh: Barnardo's 與英國國家輔導與心理治療學會調查 2,000 名 11–17 歲英國兒童。43% 曾用 AI 聊天機器人或心理健康 App 求情緒支援；40% 過去一年曾嘗試求助專業支援，其中只有 27% 表示及時獲得所需幫助；57% 認為 AI 聊天機器人無法提供同理心。
summary_en: Barnardo's and the National Counselling and Psychotherapy Society (NCPS) jointly commissioned a survey of 2,000 UK children aged 11-17 (conducted April-May 2026) for their report 'Filling the Gap? Young People's Use of AI for Mental Health Support'. 43% had used an AI chatbot or mental health app for emotional support or advice; 40% had tried to access professional support in the past year, of whom only 27% got the help they needed when they needed it; 57% said AI chatbots cannot provide empathy.
evidence_note: 官方機構報告：Barnardo's 與 NCPS 委託調查（2026 年 10 月發表），已核對 Barnardo's 官方頁

ethics_flags.note: 兒童求助專業服務的成功率低（27% 及時獲得所需幫助），AI 變成缺口的替代品，成人需主動補位。
refs: 危機處理｜自殺與自傷風險

caution: 數字為兒童自評調查；「曾使用」包括一次性使用，不等於以 AI 取代專業支援。
brief_zh: 報告：《Filling the Gap? Young People's Use of AI for Mental Health Support》（2026 年 10 月）
43% 曾用 AI 聊天機器人或 App 求情緒支援
40% 過去一年曾求助專業支援，僅 27% 及時獲得所需幫助
57% 認為 AI 聊天機器人無法提供同理心
supervision_questions: 本地兒童求助「等不到」的缺口在哪一段？我們能在個案層面先補哪一步？

posts.title: How we make AI safer for children's mental health
posts.content: Barnardo's 官方頁：與 NCPS 共同委託調查 2,000 名 11–17 歲英國兒童（2026 年 4–5 月進行），報告《Filling the Gap? Young People's Use of AI for Mental Health Support》2026 年 10 月發表。

posts.title: Children Are Turning to AI for Mental Health Support
posts.content: 轉述 Barnardo's／NCPS 報告重點的二手頁面，數字已與 Barnardo's 官方頁核對一致。

related.title_zh: 青少年為何找 AI 傾訴：不想對朋友「情緒傾倒」、覺得 AI 不會評判
related.title_en: Why teens turn to AI for emotional support
related.summary_zh: Brown 大學臨床心理學家 Jacqueline Nesi 在電子報整理 Hopelab 與哈佛 Center for Digital Thriving 的訪談報告：青少年向 AI 尋求情緒支持，是因為不想對朋友「trauma dump（情緒傾倒）」、覺得 AI 不會評判，而且隨時可用。同期也整理一篇使用 ABCD 資料的研究，發現成癮式社群媒體使用與家長回報的 ADHD 症狀有小幅關聯，Nesi 提醒不能推論因果。
related.summary_en: Clinical psychologist Jacqueline Nesi summarizes a Hopelab and Harvard Center for Digital Thriving interview report: teens turn to AI for emotional support to avoid 'trauma dumping' on friends, because AI feels non-judgmental, and because it is always available. She also covers an ABCD-based study linking addictive social media use to small increases in parent-reported ADHD symptoms, cautioning against causal claims.

related.title_zh: 英格蘭 2.4 萬青少年通用 AI 心理支援使用調查
related.title_en: General-purpose AI mental health support among 24000 adolescents England
related.summary_zh: 牛津團隊分析 OxWell 調查 24,132 名英格蘭學生。過去一年曾用通用 AI 求心理支援者佔 2.7%，其中 55.9% 認為有幫助。使用與額外支援需求集中於少數族裔與心理社會較脆弱群體。
related.summary_en: Oxford researchers analysed the OxWell survey of 24,132 students in England. In the past year 2.7% had used general-purpose AI for mental-health support, and 55.9% of users rated it helpful. Use and unmet need for more support were concentrated among ethnic-minority and psychosocially vulnerable groups.

related.title_zh: 韓國發佈心理健康 AI 使用指引：勿把聊天機器人回應當醫療診斷
related.title_en: South Korea issues mental health AI guidelines: do not treat chatbot answers as medical diagnoses
related.summary_zh: 韓國保健福祉部與韓國神經精神醫學會於 2026 年 10 月 8 日發佈心理健康 AI 使用指引，一般使用者 21 條，兒童青少年與監護人各 7 條。調查發現自評心理健康差的人最容易把 AI 回應當成醫療判斷（33.9%），向 AI 傾訴自殺衝動者近半數事後沒有求助。指引把「取得資訊或安慰」和「把診斷治療交給機器」劃出界線。
related.summary_en: The Korean Ministry of Health and Welfare and the Korean Neuropsychiatric Association released mental-health AI guidelines on 8 October 2026: 21 recommendations for general users plus 7 each for children/adolescents and guardians. Among respondents with poor self-rated mental health, 33.9% had treated AI responses as medical judgement; among 115 who disclosed depression, self-harm or suicidal urges to AI, 49.6% took no further action. The guidance allows talking to AI but asks that diagnosis, treatment and major life decisions go back to professionals.
